title: FasTac: A Curved Multispectral Vision-Based Tactile Sensor for High-Speed High-Precision 3D Shape and Force Perception
comment: 13 pages, 11 figures, including 2 pages of supplementary material. Submitted to IEEE/ASME Transactions on Mechatronics
summary: Curved tactile fingertips for dexterous manipulation must resolve fine contact geometry, distinguish normal and tangential loads, and capture transient signals. Existing curved vision-based tactile sensors struggle to combine accurate 3D reconstruction, three-axis force estimation, and high-speed processing in a compact form. This article presents FasTac, a curved vision-based tactile sensor integrating multispectral photometric stereo, dynamic-convolution force estimation, and hardware acceleration on a field-programmable gate array (FPGA). Single-image-sensor simultaneous multispectral imaging provides spatially aligned observations for robust surface normal estimation, followed by boundary-prior fast Poisson depth reconstruction. HyperForce uses position-aware dynamic convolution to model the spatially nonuniform mechanical response of curved elastomers and estimate three-axis forces. The complete image-to-normal-force pipeline is deployed on an FPGA. Experiments show that near-infrared (NIR) illumination and the boundary prior decrease depth mean absolute error (MAE) from 0.2730 mm to 0.0415 mm; HyperForce achieves normalized mean absolute error (NMAE) values of 2.74% and 2.39% for normal and shear forces, respectively; and FPGA deployment shortens processing latency from 3.26 ms on the GPU to 1.09 ms. Multi-object reconstruction, feedback grasping, and vibration measurement validate fine geometric perception, stable force feedback, and dynamic contact sensing.

AI.problem: 触觉指尖在灵巧操作中需要解析精细接触几何、区分法向与切向载荷、捕捉瞬态信号。现有弯曲型视觉触觉传感器难以同时实现高精度3D重建、三轴力估计和高速度处理，且受限于紧凑形态。论文旨在设计一种集多光谱光度立体视觉、动态卷积力估计与FPGA硬件加速于一体的弯曲视觉触觉传感器，解决上述多目标冲突问题。
AI.method: 提出FasTac弯曲视觉触觉传感器，核心包括：(1) 单图像传感器同时多光谱成像，获取空间对齐的多光谱观测用于鲁棒表面法向估计，再采用边界先验快速泊松深度重建；(2) HyperForce模块，使用位置感知动态卷积建模弯曲弹性体的空间非均匀力学响应，估计三轴力；(3) 完整的图像-法向-力处理流水线部署于FPGA上实现硬件加速。
AI.experiment: 实验明确报告了以下指标与结果：(1) 近红外照明与边界先验使深度平均绝对误差(MAE)从0.2730 mm降至0.0415 mm；(2) HyperForce在法向力和剪切力上的归一化平均绝对误差(NMAE)分别为2.74%和2.39%；(3) FPGA部署将处理延迟从GPU上的3.26 ms缩短至1.09 ms。此外，通过多物体重建、反馈抓取和振动测量实验，验证了精细几何感知、稳定力反馈与动态接触感知能力。
